guide_started_1: geetRPCS shows what you are doing as a Discord Rich Presence — automatically, for 50+ popular apps. It watches your foreground window and publishes the matching presence; when nothing recognized is active, it shows an idle status.
guide_started_2: Everything lives in the system tray: right-click the tray icon to pause, enable Private Mode, switch theme or language, open the Preview Window, manage apps and more. The tray tooltip shows the current state.
guide_started_3:
Global hotkeys:
Ctrl+Alt+P — Pause / Resume
Ctrl+Alt+V — Preview Window
Ctrl+Alt+H — Private Mode
Ctrl+Alt+R — Reload All
Ctrl+Alt+S — Statistics
guide_customize_1:
Presence texts are templates. Available placeholders:
{app_name} — display name of the detected app
{process_name} — process name (e.g. notepad)
{window_title} — current window title
{witty_text} — rotating witty line (witty.json)
In Private Mode the window title is hidden as **********.
guide_customize_2: Custom Rich Presence (tray menu) edits the idle and active texts, the elapsed-time toggle, up to two buttons and — under "Discord Application ID (advanced)" — your own Discord application: the same fields config.json holds, no JSON editing needed.
guide_customize_3: Manage Apps → expand an app to customize its Details, State, large image, elapsed time, buttons and even a per-app Application ID. Empty fields inherit the app database defaults; 'Reset to default' clears the customization.
guide_customize_4: Missing an app? Manage Apps → 'Add Custom App'. Enter the process name from Task Manager → Details (without .exe), pick a match mode, optionally match a window title, and give it a presence. Custom apps are stored in your settings and never removed by app-database updates.
guide_customize_5: For a fully custom look, create your own Discord application (Developer Portal), upload assets with the Asset Pack, then set the Application ID in Custom Rich Presence → advanced section. Buttons must use http(s) URLs, labels up to 32 characters, max 2 buttons.
guide_features_1: Mouse Energy Detector tracks how active your mouse is and shows one of five levels: Sleeping, Relaxing, Normal, Focused or Rush.
guide_features_2: Witty Narrative Engine rotates fun status lines every 60 seconds via the {witty_text} placeholder.
guide_features_3: Private Mode hides window titles. Incognito/InPrivate/private browser windows are detected automatically and hidden even when the toggle is off.
guide_features_4: The Preview Window renders your presence exactly as Discord does (fetched from the Discord API). Statistics tracks usage per app with Today / Week / Month / All Time views and CSV/JSON export.
guide_updates_1: Check for Updates downloads new releases; enable Auto-Update to update silently in the background. The app database (apps.json) updates itself automatically so new apps get supported without a new release.
guide_updates_2: Statistics accumulate locally in your user profile. Export them any time from the tray menu → Statistics → Export.
guide_trouble_1:
Presence not showing on Discord?
1. Check Discord is running and Settings → Activity Privacy allows Activity Status.
2. Make sure geetRPCS is not paused (Ctrl+Alt+P).
3. Open the Preview Window to see what is being published.
4. Restart Discord if it was started before geetRPCS.
guide_trouble_2: Changes not picked up? Press Ctrl+Alt+R (Reload All) or tray → Quick Actions → Reload All. Still stuck? Tray → Open Log File and check geetRPCS.log.
